name: Julieta Capogna
title: Senior Designer
quote:
I had the pleasure of collaborating with Mohammed while working on the design and development of a blog and website during my time at EF Academy. As the UX/UI designer on the project, I found working with him was effortless. He communicates clearly, adapts quickly to fast-paced requests, and consistently finds ways to bridge the gap between design and development smoothly.

His technical expertise made the collaboration not only productive but genuinely enjoyable. I truly appreciated the professionalism he brought to the project, and I would gladly work with him again on future collaborations.
pull: He communicates clearly, adapts quickly to fast-paced requests, and consistently finds ways to bridge the gap between design and development smoothly.
